zh-CN.title: 游戏与个性化设置
items: 斗地主和双扣可以自由点选、划选或取消手牌。牌型不符合规则时，出牌按钮会禁用。
斗地主、双扣、麻将和数字交锋均可按年度查看空间内的积分榜和胜率榜。
个性化新增聊天与广场设置入口。快捷操作更易调整，打开广场时可以选择先看好友或探索。

en.title: Games and personalization
items: Tap, drag to select, and deselect cards freely in Dou Dizhu and Shuangkou. Play is enabled for legal combinations.
Dou Dizhu, Shuangkou, Mahjong, and Code Duel all have annual points and win-rate rankings for your space.
Chat and Square now have separate personalization settings. Customize chat shortcuts and choose whether Square opens to Friends or Explore.
